abilities.name: PML
abilities.description: Piconit Metastasis Level. A Universal Index of piconit metastasis; ordinary characters begin at PML 1 unless the campaign or GM specifies otherwise.

abilities.name: Trade Rank
abilities.description: Professional advancement within a Trade organization; distinct from PML and Assembly Rank.

abilities.name: Social Rank
abilities.description: Social position derived from background and society.

abilities.name: Wealth Rank
abilities.description: Wealth/economic position derived from background and other adjustments.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.description: 3 + 3 × FOR/3; the amount of Fatigue and Weariness ignored before penalties.

abilities.name: Resilience
abilities.description: 3 + 2 × POW/3; the amount of Stress ignored before penalties.

abilities.name: Resistance
abilities.description: 3 + 4 × SIZ/3; the amount of Rads ignored before penalties.

abilities.name: Hitpoints
abilities.description: 10 + REF DM + POW DM + PRE DM + MOV DM, minimum 1; then add +3 × PML.

abilities.name: Bodypoints
abilities.description: SIZ plus adjustments by Age Group, Species, Sex, and Trade, minimum 1; Overweight uses the pre-Overweight Build.

abilities.name: Gasp Limit
abilities.description: Scalar FOR minus 10 Combat Turns.

abilities.name: Sleep Limit
abilities.description: Scalar FOR minus 5 Hours.

abilities.name: Manapool
abilities.description: Manapool Index = ZED + SIZ DM.

abilities.name: Favor Dice
abilities.description: At the start of each game session, a Player-character or Major NPC has Favor dice equal to PML, plus applicable Trait adjustments such as Deity.

abilities.name: Physicality
abilities.description: The higher of STR or SIZ.

abilities.name: Recovery Rate
abilities.description: The higher of 1 or 3 + POW DM + FOR DM, plus floor(SIZ/5); PML adds floor(PML/3).

abilities.name: Movement Ability
abilities.description: Derived from Stature and adjusted MOV; MOV is the character’s Run movement, with Walk and Jog derived separately.

abilities.name: Throwing Ability
abilities.description: Uses the Lob, Pitch, and Hurl methods; Pitch is the default.

abilities.name: Carrying Ability
abilities.description: Varies by STR and SIZ, with allometric scaling for non-Human-sized Sophonts.

abilities.name: Cellburn Limit
abilities.description: The higher of 1 or PRE DM + KNO DM + POW DM.

abilities.name: Max Advantage
abilities.description: 1 + floor((PML − 1)/3); maximum Advantage dice for a Test after flattening, subject to the rule exceptions.

abilities.name: Stature
abilities.description: Character height modifier used when deriving physical measurements and Movement.

abilities.name: Build
abilities.description: Character body-build modifier used to determine SIZ / Index Weight.

abilities.name: Fatigue
abilities.description: Short-lived physical energy/effort concern; recovers quickly and is resisted by Endurance.

abilities.name: Weariness
abilities.description: Long-term energy/effort concern; recovers through rest and sleep and is resisted by Endurance.

abilities.name: Stress
abilities.description: Longer-lived psychological concern; recovers through rest and is resisted by Resilience.

abilities.name: Rads
abilities.description: Radiation/magic exposure concern; resisted by Resistance.
